When Permit Is Needed

  • Over 8'6" wide
  • Over 13'6" high
  • Trailer over 53' long

Special Information Needed

  • Overweight- gross wt, # of axles, axle load, axle spacing and manufactured tire limit
  • Make and year of mobile home
  • Seal and container #

Times Of Movement

  • Movement is permitted during daytime hours only, excluding holidays. Weekend travel allowed for overweight only
  • Prohibited holidays: New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, & Christmas and days of observation other than calendar date as well as additional days of observation before/after date
  • Curfews noted on permit

When Pilot/Escort Vehicle is Required

All roadways:

  • Over 12' up to 14' wide (if pavement is 24' or larger wide)-1 front
  • Over 12' wide (if pavement is less than 24' wide)-1 front/1 rear
  • Over 14' to 16' wide (each lane must be 12' wide)-1 front/1 rear
  • Over 16’ wide-Limited access facility:(daytime)2 escorts /(nighttime) 1 escort + 1 law enforcer
  • State maintained roadways: 2 law enforcement escorts at all times.
  • Over 22’ wide- Route survey
  • ***
  • Over 95' long- 1 rear
  • Over 95' long- 1 rear
  • Over 150’ (limited access facility) 1 escort; other roadways-2 escorts
  • Over 250’ long-1 escort & 1 law enforcer
  • ***
  • Height up to 14’6”-Travel all days/all hours
  • 14' 6" high to 16’ high-Daytime hours only, excluding holidays/ 1 front w/ height pole
  • Over 18’-route survey verifying clearance + 6”; Daytime hours only; 1 escort + 1 law enforcer

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle

  • Vehicle 2000 lbs.-26000 lbs GVW licensed & operated by a qualified escort/pilot
  • Bumper or roof mounted signs or both (“OVERSIZE LOAD”): yellow w/ black letters 10” high w/ brush stroke 1½ wide visible from front and rear.
  • Placards or signs (8” x 12” min.) on both sides of vehicle showing name of company or owner or driver of vehicle w/ name & phone # of owner/driver
  • Class 2 amber warning lights mounted so visible to all approaching traffic at a distance of at least 500’.
  • 2 flags (red or fluorescent orange) 18” x 18” min. Mounted 40-70 degree angle on roof rack
  • Additional equipment:
  • 2-way communications device;
  • 1-5 lb. or larger fire extinguishers;
  • “STOP/GO” or “STOP/SLOW” paddle (18” x 18”) w/ 6” high letters;
  • safety orange vest/shirt/jacket; class 2 for daytime moves,class 3 for night moves;
  • 1-12” x 12” hand-held flag (red or fluorescent orange);
  • 2 “OVERSIZE LOAD” banners (yellow w/ black letters) (7’ long x 18” high) in case permitted load/vehicle loses sign;
  • Hard hat;
  • 3 reflective triangles/36” traffic cones;
  • Height pole

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle Operator

  • Must be one of the following:
  • FL law enforcement officer in enforcement vehicle
  • Person meeting the following requirements:
  • Must have successfully completed the FDOT Pilot/Escort Flagging course (re-qualification required every 4 years)
  • Must have a valid CDL class A, B, or C or successfully completed the NSC 8-hour Defensive Driving course
  • Must be at least 18 yrs. of age
  • A person qualified by another state’s authorizing agency
